Package com.apfelkomplott.apfelkomplott.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.apfelkomplott.apfelkomplott.controller.GameController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/game") public class GameController extends Object
Exposes the HTTP API used by the web frontend to start a game, advance game phases, buy cards, choose events, and inspect the current game state.
